title: Matched-Input Estimates Differ in Sign Across Architectures: Auditing EEG Foundation Models on Motor Imagery
abstract: arXiv:2609.23924v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Pretrained EEG foundation models are increasingly proposed as general-purpose encoders for brain-computer interfaces, yet recent benchmarks disagree about when their representations transfer to downstream tasks. We audit LaBraM and CBraMod on motor imagery under a validation-locked protocol in which preprocessing, architecture, optimization, freeze depth, checkpoint, temperature, and method selection are determined using training-session data only. On four-class BCI Competition IV-2a, every supervised comparator evaluated here outperforms every foundation-model configuration, including validation-selected fine-tuning. We then examine a key confound: foundation models and task-specific decoders are normally evaluated using different input pipelines. Retraining three supervised architectures on the broadband arrays consumed by the foundation models produces matched-input accuracy differences of opposite sign across architectures: broadband

translated_title: 相同输入下不同架构的估计结果符号相反：对运动想象任务中EEG基础模型的审计
translated_abstract: 预训练的EEG基础模型越来越多地被提出作为脑机接口的通用编码器，然而近期的基准测试对于其表征何时能够迁移到下游任务存在分歧。我们在一个验证锁定协议下对LaBraM和CBraMod在运动想象任务上进行了审计，在该协议中，预处理、架构、优化、冻结深度、检查点、温度和方法选择均仅使用训练会话数据来确定。在四分类BCI Competition IV-2a数据集上，本文评估的每一个有监督对照方法都优于所有基础模型配置，包括通过验证选择的微调。随后，我们检验了一个关键的混淆因素：基础模型和任务特定解码器通常使用不同的输入流水线进行评估。在基础模型所使用的宽带输入阵列上重新训练三个有监督架构后，产生了跨架构符号相反的匹配输入精度差异：宽带……
tldr: 该研究在验证锁定协议下审计了EEG基础模型LaBraM和CBraMod在运动想象任务上的表现，发现所有有监督方法均优于基础模型配置，并揭示了输入流水线差异会导致匹配输入下的精度差异在不同架构间符号相反这一关键混淆因素。
en_tdlr: This study audits EEG foundation models LaBraM and CBraMod on motor imagery under a validation-locked protocol, finding that all supervised comparators outperform foundation-model configurations, and reveals a key confound in which matched-input accuracy differences are of opposite sign across architectures due to differing input pipelines.
